issue_title: [Enhancement] Todo 类缺少 __eq__ 和 __hash__ 方法，无法进行对象比较或用作 dict 键
implementation_summary: Added __eq__ and __hash__ methods to Todo dataclass. The __eq__ method compares todos by id only, allowing todos to be compared and used in sets/dicts by their unique id. The __hash__ method hashes by id to maintain consistency with __eq__.
